name: Aizuka Hime
source:
A swim club member who has a crush on the protagonist and constantly follows them around, calling out “Senpai!” She's a kouhai.

Since entering school, she's admired the protagonist and openly confesses her feelings. More than a fan... her behavior borders on stalker-like?

When things don't go her way, she throws a fit and immediately starts firing off missiles—a slightly dangerous personality.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/ironmaiden/chara.html]official site[/url]]
